title: The Equation That Explains (Nearly) Everything!
summary: PBS Space Time explains the Standard Model Lagrangian, the single equation encapsulating the particle physics theory, and visualizes what its terms mean.
why: Recommended as a good visual walkthrough of the Standard Model equation for people who want to understand its terms.

quote.text: PBS Spacetime has a very good video[0] that helps visualize what's going on in the equation, recent too!
